words.zh: 忘记（过去式 forgot，过去分词 forgotten）

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.en: I bought two expensive dictionaries here half an hour ago, but I forgot to take them with me.
lines.zh: 半小时以前我在这里买了两本很贵的辞典，但是我忘了拿走。

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.en: The lady who is standing behind the counter.
lines.zh: 站在柜台后面的那位女士。

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.en: The books which are on the counter.

lines.speaker: Manager
lines.en: Did you serve this gentleman half an hour ago, Caroline?
lines.zh: 卡罗琳，半小时前你接待过这位先生吗？

lines.speaker: Manager
lines.en: He says he's the man who bought these books.
lines.zh: 他说他就是买这两本书的人。

lines.speaker: Caroline
lines.en: The man who I served was wearing a hat.
lines.zh: 我接待的那个人戴着一顶帽子。

lines.speaker: Manager
lines.en: Have you got a hat, sir?

lines.speaker: Manager
lines.en: Would you put it on, please?

lines.speaker: Manager
lines.en: Is this the man that you served, Caroline?
lines.zh: 卡罗琳，这就是你接待过的那个人吗？

drills.en: I bought two expensive dictionaries here half an hour ___.
drills.zh: 半小时以前我在这里买了两本很贵的辞典。

drills.en: The lady ___ is standing behind the counter served me.
drills.zh: 站在柜台后面的那位女士接待了我。

drills.en: The books ___ are on the counter are mine.
drills.zh: 柜台上的那几本书是我的。

drills.en: He is the man ___ bought these books.
drills.zh: 他就是买这几本书的人。

drills.en: The man who I served ___ wearing a hat.
drills.zh: 我接待的那个人戴着一顶帽子。

drills.en: She is the woman ___ I met at the party.
drills.zh: 她就是我在聚会上遇见的那位女士。

drills.en: Who is making all that noise? The men ___ are repairing the road.
drills.zh: 谁在制造这么大的噪音？是正在修路的那些人。
